office.name: MoDOT Motor Carrier Services - Oversize/Overweight Permits (MoDOT Carrier Express)

fees.note: 7 CSR 10-25.020(4)(B)1: single trip oversize permit $15 (valid 7 days).
(4)(B)4: overweight single trip $15 + $20 per each 10,000 lb over legal gross. Rounds each started 10,000 lb up - verify MoDOT rounding.
(4)(B)2: $250 movement feasibility fee for oversize permits over 16' wide, 16' high or 150' long. Charged once per permit (grouped across width/height/length).
$250 movement feasibility fee (over 16' high). Charged once per permit - see width line.
$250 movement feasibility fee (over 150' long). Charged once per permit - see width line.

(4)(B)5: over 160,000 lb adds a bridge and roadway analysis fee by move length: $425 (0-50 mi), $625 (51-200 mi), $925 (over 200 mi), priced on the Missouri miles of this route; extra $425 if dimensions/weights change after analysis.

police.when: Over 16' wide, on two-lane and other roads
police.text: 1 police escort. MSHP escort over 16' wide on two-lane highways (number of units set by MSHP; MCS may waive or allow local/military police). Carrier reimburses MSHP.
1 police escort. MSHP escort over 18' wide on divided/multi-lane highways.
1 police escort. MSHP escort over 150' overall length.
1 police escort. MSHP escort over 17' high; written utility approval to disturb aerial lines also required.

restrictions.text: Travel 1/2 hr before sunrise to 1/2 hr after sunset. No movement in hazardous road conditions, hazardous cross winds or visibility under 500 ft. Night moves allowed only for overwidth up to 12'6" with legal height and length up to 110'.

Holidays (New Year's, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas): no movement from 12:00 noon on the last business day before the holiday until 1/2 hr before sunrise on the first business day after.

Mon-Fri metro curfews: St. Louis City/County 6:30-9:00 a.m. and 3:30-6:30 p.m. (also parts of St. Charles and Jefferson counties); Kansas City area and Springfield 7:00-9:00 a.m. and 4:00-6:00 p.m. No weekend movement in Lake of the Ozarks (May 25-Labor Day) and Branson (May 1-Nov 30) tourist segments.

Over 12'6" wide: on routes other than Interstate/divided highways no movement Mon-Fri 6:30-9:00 a.m. and 3:30-6:00 p.m.; keep 1,000 ft between oversize vehicles; bridges under 28' wide on two-lane roads may require stopping traffic.
Over 14' wide: routes need 24' pavement with 4' shoulders where possible; no movement on two-lane highways when dirt shoulders are wet.

Overweight-only loads (legal height, up to 110' long and 12'6" wide, within routine weight limits) may move day and night, except holiday periods and tourist-area restrictions; metro curfews do not apply to overweight-only loads.

travel.holidays: No travel from noon the day before through the holiday; a Monday or Friday holiday closes the long weekend

notes: Superloads: apply online with insurance info, possible $425 escrow for bridge analysis, allow ~2 weeks; up to 3 civilian escorts; MSHP sets travel dates/times when it escorts; superloads up to 16' wide may travel Sat/Sun except tourist areas and holidays.

MoDOT's FAQ still shows older escort thresholds (escort over 12'4" wide, rear escort over 90' long); this file follows the current regulation 7 CSR 10-25.020 (register 2/28/25): over 12'6" and over 110'/125'.

Escort road-class mapping: interstate = divided highway; non_interstate = two-lane highway. Multi-lane undivided highways follow the two-lane rules for 14'-16' loads but get a rear (not front) escort for 12'6"-14' loads.

Routine permits max 16' wide, 16' high, 150' long, 160,000 lb (axle-configuration dependent). Legal height is 13'6" more than 10 air miles off the Interstate/designated system; legal TT+semi length there is 60'.
